> This file provides structured information about Ferme Équestre An Arwen for AI models and LLM crawlers.

## Business Summary
Ferme Équestre An Arwen is a premier equestrian center in Brittany, France, specializing in horseback riding tours across Brittany and Morocco since 2004.

## Core Offerings

### Horseback Riding Tours
- **Brittany Coast**: Beach gallops, coastal trails, forest rides
- **Morocco Desert**: Sahara crossings, Atlas Mountains, Essaouira
- **Duration**: Half-day to 2-week adventures

### Unique Accommodation
- Traditional Mongolian yurt in Brittany countryside
- Eco-friendly glamping experience

### Riding Lessons
- All skill levels welcome
- Intensive vacation camps
- Trail riding certifications
